title: HyperHealth: a pilot study on AI-driven COVID-19 detection using hyperspectral fingertip images.
summary: Pilot ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05044780 collected hyperspectral fingertip images and trained classifiers against PCR/antigen status. The reported test set contained 83 COVID-negative and only 2 positive samples; some runs missed positive cases. The result is reported in the Scientific Reports. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
